CTS DPS, the complete picture: how a document becomes a reviewed covenant result

Long image

A

Answer

Spring sends a job. A Python worker claims it, and a CrewAI Flow reads the document with rules first and the Document Agent second. Every value is checked against its page and the Java business rules. The result then waits in DPS until Spring pulls it and a person approves.

  1. Spring and DPS talk only through jobs: POST /dps/v1/jobs in `dps/src/dps/api/jobs.py:328`, and results come back from GET /dps/v1/jobs/{id}/result.1
  2. One CrewAI Flow runs per job, and one Document Agent reads with the job's skill pack and 6 tools.2
  3. Every AI answer must quote its page or it is dropped, and a whole-document ledger stops a covenant sentence going missing.3
  4. Business rules stay in Java inside Spring. DPS calls them as batched tools, and DPS never decides compliance.4

Applies toRepository cts-dps at commit 6d0ff8dpaths from the repository rootPython code under dps/src/dps/20 Nov 2026, updated 23 Nov 2026 (Phase 1-2 fixes, traces with OpenTelemetry + Langfuse)

What is inside the DPS, what is outside, and how do they connect?

Diagram structure

  • Spring app (CTS) spring
  • DPS job API api
  • SQL Server schema dps queue
  • Python worker worker
  • Ingest + sandbox parse ingest
  • DMS store dms
  • Event feed feed
  • Skill runner runner
  • CrewAI Flow per job flow
  • derived/ store derived
  • Spring business rules java
  • Spring tools client tools
  • Document Agent agent
  • Model gateway gateway
  • Bank Azure OpenAI azure
  • Langfuse (traces) langfuse
  • ui → spring · upload, review
  • spring → api · submit job
  • api → queue · insert row
  • worker → queue · claim job
  • worker → ingest · read file
  • ingest → dms · SHA-256 read
  • ingest → derived · page model
  • worker → flow · kickoff
  • flow → runner · run skills
  • runner → queue · save run
  • runner → feed · event
  • runner → agent · read pages
  • agent → gateway · model call
  • gateway → azure · HTTPS
  • agent → tools · Java tools
  • tools → java · HTTP batch
  • feed → spring · pull events
  • worker → langfuse · OTLP traces
  • gateway → langfuse · AI call spans
  1. Spring app (CTS) ↗

    Spring submits a job with POST /dps/v1/jobs. The contract is `contracts/dps-jobs-api.yaml`.

  2. DPS job API ↗

    `dps/src/dps/api/jobs.py:328` submit_job validates the request, checks the SHA-256 and returns the running job for a duplicate.

  3. SQL Server schema dps ↗

    The job is a row in dps_job. The worker claims it with compare-and-set in `dps/src/dps/jobs.py:85` claim.

  4. Python worker ↗

    `dps/src/dps/worker.py:126` run_once polls, holds a lease with a heartbeat and fences every write by attempt.

  5. Ingest + sandbox parse ↗

    The file is read from the DMS by version and SHA-256, inspected, and parsed in a child process with no network.

  6. CrewAI Flow per job ↗

    `dps/src/dps/flows/skill_job.py:28` SkillJobFlow runs two steps per job: run_skills (the skill pack) and save_result (the run, the event, the job status).

  7. Skill runner ↗

    `dps/src/dps/skills/runner.py:938` run_onboard classifies, runs rules, the page finder, 4 agent reads, the ledger, Java checks, codes and the score.

  8. Document Agent ↗

    `dps/src/dps/agent/document_agent.py:287` make_agent builds one CrewAI agent with the pack's tools.

  9. Model gateway ↗

    `dps/src/dps/agent/gateway.py:289` call_json applies the budget, retries, breaker and masking, and sends only selected pages to Azure.

  10. Spring tools client ↗

    `dps/src/dps/integrations/spring_tools.py:151` calls the Java business rules once per document.

  11. Event feed ↗

    The result and its event are written in one transaction. Spring reads GET /dps/v1/events.

  12. Langfuse (traces) ↗

    Every job is one OpenTelemetry trace (`dps/src/dps/ops/observability.py:218`); each model call is a chat <deployment> span (`dps/src/dps/agent/gateway.py:237`). Langfuse shows them on the laptop (`deploy/observability/docker-compose.langfuse.yml`): ports on 127.0.0.1, telemetry off, no document text by default.

Architect decisionWhere in the code
Spring and DPS on the same VM`deploy/docker-compose.cts-dps.yml`: separate containers with CPU and memory limits
They talk only through jobs`dps/src/dps/api/jobs.py` (POST /dps/v1/jobs), `dps/src/dps/jobs.py` (the queue)
A Python worker polls the queue`dps/src/dps/worker.py` (Worker.run_once, lease-based claim)
Each job has its own context with a small set of skills, tools and prompts`dps/src/dps/flows/skill_job.py`, dps/src/dps/skills/<pack>/pack.yaml
One agent with many skills and tools`dps/src/dps/agent/document_agent.py` (make_agent, read)

  1. DPS job API ↗

  2. Worker ↗

    The worker claims the job and runs ingest and the sandbox parse to build the page model.

  3. Flow + runner ↗

    AI 1 classifies with rules first. The agent gives a second opinion only when the rules are unsure.

    AI 2 reads covenants in 4 focused parts: financial, undertakings, reporting and events of default.

How do the agent, its skills and its tools work?

make_agent builds a fresh CrewAI Agent for each read, with no memory and no delegation. Its role, prompt, answer schema and limits come from the job's skill pack.5

SkillPathJobTools it may use
covenants`dps/src/dps/skills/covenants/`ONBOARD agreement, EXTRACT_AGREEMENTpage_text, search_text, find_definition, covenant_library, validate_formula
sanction`dps/src/dps/skills/sanction/`EXTRACT_SANCTIONthe same 5
amendment_diff`dps/src/dps/skills/amendment_diff/`EXTRACT_AMENDMENTthe same 5
schedule_terms`dps/src/dps/skills/schedule_terms/`inside covenants, sanction, amendmentpage_text, search_text, find_definition
certificate`dps/src/dps/skills/certificate/`EXTRACT_CERTIFICATEpage_text, search_text, lookup_identifier
statement_lines`dps/src/dps/skills/statement_lines/`EXTRACT_STATEMENT (statement reader + optional AI second reader)none
waiver`dps/src/dps/skills/waiver/`EXTRACT_WAIVER, ONBOARD waiverpage_text, search_text, find_definition, covenant_library
reconcile_set`dps/src/dps/skills/reconcile_set/`RECONCILE_SET (no model; built from earlier runs)none
commentary`dps/src/dps/skills/commentary/`DRAFT_COMMENTARYnone

Each skill folder holds pack.yaml (version, jobs, model route, tools, page budget, field risk), prompt.md, schema.json and rules.py.

ToolLine in `dps/src/dps/agent/document_agent.py`What it doesBacked by
page_text147Open any page of this job's documentthe page model
search_text164Search the whole documentthe page model
find_definition184Find a definition such as "EBITDA means"the page model
covenant_library211Look up the bank's covenant libraryJava, through spring_tools.py
validate_formula234Check a formula in the bank's DSLJava
lookup_identifier253Match a CP, obligor or facility idJava
  1. Prompt. A fixed header says document text is data, not instructions. The skill's prompt, schema and selected whole pages follow.
  2. Call. The gateway sends it to the small, strong or vision route, with retries at 2, 8 and 30 s, a breaker, a token budget and masking.
  3. Schema check. The answer must match schema.json. One repair call is allowed, then MODEL_OUTPUT_INVALID.
  4. Grounding. Every quote must be on its page, or the item is dropped with AI_UNGROUNDED.
  5. Vote. Agreement gives RULES+AI_CONFIRMED. A difference gives MODELS_DISAGREE and goes to review.

If the model is down, the job does not fail. It falls back to the rules, and the fields go to review.6

8

Rules first, then the agent: how are the two readings combined?

Every skill reads with its rules first: deterministic, free, page and quote on every value. With AI switched on, the Document Agent then reads the selected pages with the skill's prompt, schema and tools. Code compares the two readings; the model never decides on its own.

  1. Rules. `runner._extract` calls the skill's rules.py. For covenants: the agreement extractor (`extract_terms`), the safety net (`possible_covenants`) and step-down tables.
  2. Pages. Covenants: every page is scored (rule pages, covenant headings, duty sentences, definitions) into up to 12 reads of 25 pages (`covenant_batches`), read in 4 focused parts. Other skills: the rule pages plus keyword pages (`select_pages`).
  3. Agent. `agent_proposals`: one fresh CrewAI agent per read, the pack's tools only, through the model gateway to the bank's Azure.
  4. Schema and grounding. The answer must match the skill's schema; every quote must be on the page it names (`grounded`), or the item is dropped.
  5. Vote. `vote`: same value = RULES+AI_CONFIRMED, confidence at least 0.95. Different value = MODELS_DISAGREE: the rules' value stays, both readings are shown, the field goes to a person. Covenants are matched one to one by taxonomy code, party and basis (`_vote_covenants`).
  6. Agent only. `_agent_only`: what only the agent found is added with method AI and issue AI_ONLY, and goes to a person.
  7. Rules only. The rules' value stands; the scorer lowers its confidence (AI_MISSED) and high-risk fields are reviewed anyway.
  8. Ledger. Covenants: every duty sentence of the whole document ends FINDING, COVERED, NOT_A_COVENANT (the agent's residual read) or UNRESOLVED (a review item) (`ledger.settle`).
  9. Checks and score. Taxonomy codes, company and conditions, Java formula check, direction checks, number in its own quote, then the confidence and route (`scoring.route`): HIGH risk always reviewed.
OutcomeMethod on the fieldStatus
Rules and agent agreeRULES+AI_CONFIRMEDauto-accepted only when the risk and confidence allow; every covenant is HIGH risk, so reviewed
Rules and agent disagreeRULES with issue MODELS_DISAGREE and both valuesNEEDS_REVIEW
Agent onlyAI with issue AI_ONLYNEEDS_REVIEW
Rules onlyRULESby score; covenants reviewed
Read from a page imageAI_VISION with issue READ_FROM_IMAGENEEDS_REVIEW
AI switched offRULES, warning AI_NOT_USEDNEEDS_REVIEW

Which fields does each skill extract?

Every field has the same envelope: id, group, name, value, source (page, quote, box, cell), method, confidence, signals, issues, status. The value keys depend on the skill.

SkillField groupvalue keys
covenantsFINANCIAL_COVENANT, NON_FINANCIAL_COVENANT, INFO_COVENANT, POSSIBLE_COVENANT, EVENT_OF_DEFAULTmetric, code, operator, threshold, unit, frequency, schedule (step-downs), cure, scope (obligor, basis, facilityRefs), conditions, firstTestDate, equityCure, baskets, clause; libraryMatch (covenantMasterId)
schedule_termsSCHEDULE_TERMkind (TESTING_CALENDAR, REPORTING_DEADLINE, REPAYMENT, INTEREST_RESET, CURE_WINDOW), rule, frequency, daysAfterPeriodEnd, dates, amount, currency
sanctionAGREEMENT_TERMkey (SANCTIONED_AMOUNT, FACILITY_TYPE, TENOR_MONTHS, INTEREST_RATE, SECURITY, CONDITIONS_PRECEDENT, VALIDITY), text, amount, currency, date
amendment_diffthe covenant's groupthe covenant keys plus change (type ADD / CHANGE / DELETE, clause, effectiveDate, appliedCovenantId, explanation); result also has amendedSet

Why are the Java rules wrapped as Python tools?

Parsing, OCR and AI stay in Python, and business rules stay in Java inside Spring, so the bank has one rule engine. The contract is `contracts/spring-tools.yaml` and the client is SpringTools in `dps/src/dps/integrations/spring_tools.py:113`.4

Endpoint in SpringUsed byWhen
POST /api/v1/dps-tools/formulas/validatevalidate_formula tool, verify_with_springevery covenant with a formula
GET /api/v1/dps-tools/covenant-librarycovenant_library toolmatching names to the bank's library
POST /api/v1/dps-tools/lookupslookup_identifier, `dps/src/dps/analyze/identify.py`CP, obligor and facility ids in a document
POST /api/v1/dps-tools/events (optional)`dps/src/dps/worker.py`when Spring wants DPS to push events
Batched
one HTTP call per document, never one per field
Bounded
timeout, retries and a circuit breaker
Degrading
if Spring is down the field gets SPRING_UNAVAILABLE and goes to review; the job carries on
Test stand-in
`dps/tests/stub_spring.py`

16

What happens after extraction?

  1. The result is saved in dps_run and its event in dps_event_feed, in one transaction.
  2. Spring reads GET /dps/v1/events, then GET /dps/v1/jobs/{id}/result, and shows each field with its page, quote and box.
  3. A person accepts, edits or rejects each field through POST /dps/v1/jobs/{id}/review; a new run is saved.
  4. Review decisions feed dps_review_decision; corrections become golden-set candidates (dps_golden_candidate) and confirmed statement labels are remembered per borrower (dps_label_memory).
  5. Spring approves, persists the covenants as immutable, updates the schedule and runs the compliance calculation.

The agent works during extraction, never after it

The agent only proposes, and code checks every proposal. DPS never decides compliance or a breach.

17

How does one document travel through DPS, end to end?

  1. Upload. The RM uploads in CTS, the DMS keeps one immutable copy, and Spring posts a job with the file reference and the CP, borrower and facility IDs (`dps/src/dps/api/jobs.py:328`).
  2. Queue. DPS validates the request, checks the SHA-256, stops duplicates and writes one dps_job row (`dps/src/dps/api/jobs.py:254`).
  3. Claim. A worker claims the job with an atomic update and keeps a lease with a heartbeat (`dps/src/dps/jobs.py:85`).
  4. Check the file. The real type is checked, and encrypted, broken or macro files are refused (`dps/src/dps/ingest/inspect.py:65`).
  5. Parse. A child process with no network builds the page model: pypdf text, pdfplumber positions, and RapidOCR on pypdfium2 images for scans (`dps/src/dps/parse/page_model.py:30`).
  6. Store the parse. The page model is saved once in derived/ and listed in dps_artifact; the original file never changes.
  7. Start the flow. One CrewAI Flow runs per job, in two steps: run the skill pack, then save the result (`dps/src/dps/flows/skill_job.py:28`).
  8. Classify. Rules score each type; the agent gives a quoted second opinion only when unsure (`dps/src/dps/analyze/classify.py:382`).
  9. Choose the skill. The type picks the pack in ONBOARD_PACKS; other job types pick the pack whose pack.yaml lists them (`dps/src/dps/skills/runner.py:930`, `dps/src/dps/skills/__init__.py:83`).
  10. Pack limits. pack.yaml sets the model route, tools, up to 12 reads of 25 pages, 8 tool calls, 3 turns, 240 s, 700,000 tokens and field risk (`dps/src/dps/skills/covenants/pack.yaml`).
  11. Rules first. The pack's rules read the whole document without a model (`dps/src/dps/skills/covenants/rules.py:84`).
  12. Choose pages. The agent never gets the whole document; the page finder sends ranked pages in 4 focused reads (`dps/src/dps/skills/covenants/pages.py:98`).
  13. Agent read. A fresh agent with the skill's prompt, schema and tools reads through the gateway to the bank's Azure (`dps/src/dps/agent/document_agent.py:287`).
  14. Check answers. Schema check with one repair, the quote must be on its page, the number must be in the quote, then the vote (`dps/src/dps/skills/common.py:53`).
  15. Nothing missed. The ledger gives every duty sentence one state and sends unexplained ones to a second read, then to a person (`dps/src/dps/skills/covenants/ledger.py:205`).
  16. Java rules. Formulas and library names are checked by Spring in one batched call (`dps/src/dps/integrations/spring_tools.py:151`).
  17. Name and score. A taxonomy code and a confidence per field; risky or unsure fields go to review (`dps/src/dps/skills/covenants/codes.py:34`).
  18. Save. dps.result/1.0 goes to dps_run with its event in one transaction (`dps/src/dps/skills/runner.py:883`).
  19. Review. Spring pulls the result; a person accepts, edits or rejects; Spring decides compliance (`dps/src/dps/api/review.py:156`).

Is the extracted data sent to the agent?

The parsed text stays on the bank's machine. The agent sees only the selected pages for its read, through the gateway, on the bank's own Azure endpoint. Code checks everything it returns, and the agent never writes anything.

Say this plainly in the demo

On real bank documents the rules alone find the clearly written covenants and put every other duty sentence in front of a person. Some rule quotes point at a contents line, and the reviewer rejects those. The agent settles most of the rest; it explained 100% on our 85-page test agreements on live Azure.

Four links on the list failed on 19 Nov 2026: three return "not found" (Workspace, Gresham House, DCB) and one fails its certificate check (South Indian Bank). The list has no statements, so the assessment flow uses our labelled statements in golden-set\documents\.

What a trace carries

Ids, counts, times, model and tokens. No file name, document text, prompt or answer, unless the bank switches on DPS_AI_TRACE_TEXT (then masked). Langfuse runs on 127.0.0.1 with its telemetry off. If it is down, spans are dropped and the job finishes normally.
